relations.subject: Duan Wenjie
relations.object: Chongqing National College of Fine Arts
relations.evidence: he graduated from the Department of Chinese Painting at Chongqing National College of Fine Arts (now the Central Academy of Fine Arts) in 1945

relations.subject: Duan Wenjie
relations.role: Acting Head of the Archaeological Group
relations.evidence: joined the National Dunhuang Art Institute in July 1946 as Acting Head of the Archaeological Group

relations.subject: Duan Wenjie
relations.role: Head of the Fine Arts Group and acting director
relations.evidence: in 1950, he became Head of the Fine Arts Group of the Dunhuang Institute of Cultural Relics and acting director of the Dunhuang Institute of Cultural Relics

relations.subject: Duan Wenjie
relations.evidence: in 1980, he became First Deputy Director of the Dunhuang Institute of Cultural Relics

relations.subject: Duan Wenjie
relations.evidence: He was appointed honorary professor at Tokyo University of the Arts in 1986

relations.subject: Duan Wenjie
relations.evidence: retired as honorary director of the Dunhuang Academy in 1998
